I am an old woman, 63 years, and this small piece of land is just a small garden, less than a quarter acre. I have no money for the fertilizer from the shop — one bag is too much for this small plot anyway, and the price is too high for me. I will put the manure from my few animals and the kitchen ash like I always do, and I will plant the seeds I saved from last season, mixed together as I have done for many years. The rains here in Mbeya are good, so I do not need to bring water, and I will work it myself with my hoe — maybe my daughter helps me some days when she comes.
